dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/19] The scale can be used as a screening and diagnostic tool and as a measure of severity of depression. It covers 17 symptom areas, which are rated on a seven point or five point scale, with the higher rating suggesting more severe difficulties.18 In our study population the Cronbach's α coefficient was 0.84. We trained and supervised research assistants, who were blinded to the intervention, to carry out the ratings.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/19] The children's depression rating scale-revised18 is an observer rated scale developed specifically for children but often used for adolescents.20 It has sound psychometric properties,21 is widely used in clinical research,21 and has been used to assess change in severity of depression in studies of treatment.20 22 The scale can be used as a screening and diagnostic tool and as a measure of severity of depression. It covers 17 symptom areas, which are rated on a seven point or five point scale, with the higher rating suggesting more severe difficulties.18 In our study population the Cronbach's α coefficient was 0.84. We trained and supervised research assistants, who were blinded to the intervention, to carry out the ratings.
